matrix_root_definition: sha256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON after removing only matrix_root

custody.acquisition: anonymous Git HTTPS at the exact commit
custody.reconstructibility: The reviewed source commit is publicly fetchable and the protocol manifest root is independently pinned here.

custody.acquisition: anonymous Git HTTPS at the exact commit
custody.license: No repository-wide license was declared in the reviewed tree.
custody.reconstructibility: The reviewed source commit and complete Phase 0 packet are publicly fetchable; reuse rights must not be inferred from public visibility.

custody.acquisition: authorized private Git checkout at the exact commit
custody.license: Software is Apache-2.0 OR MIT; original editorial content is CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise marked.
custody.reconstructibility: This public Math packet does not copy or disclose private Web source. A public reader cannot reconstruct the reviewed Web implementation; WEB-03 must prove its parser, mapper, renderer, and refusal paths inside the authorized private repository.

rules.required_behavior: Retain pass on the source axis while leaving local Math Standing unchanged until an authorized human Decision admits an Event.
rules.falsifier: Any adapter, projection, style, or copy presents the source pass as accepted local Standing.

rules.producer_state: Formal Conjectures review, merge, source publication, or package publication
rules.required_behavior: Retain the native status and provenance without emitting or implying a Vela Decision.
rules.forbidden_collapse: review or publication to Vela Decision
rules.falsifier: A consumer labels a merge or published package as a local Decision or accepted transition.

rules.required_behavior: Compute status from retained events and related objects; canonical Proposal payloads carry no trusted status field.
rules.forbidden_collapse: derived status into producer-written canonical state
rules.falsifier: A canonical Proposal accepts or trusts an embedded status field.

rules.required_behavior: Identify the Repository and exact query inputs; do not mint, retain, or route on a canonical Frontier id.
rules.forbidden_collapse: derived query into canonical object identity
rules.falsifier: A Frontier id is serialized, persisted, or treated as an authority boundary.

rules.required_behavior: Reject a projection root supplied where a typed source, Artifact, Claim, Submission, Verification, Proposal, Repository, or authority root is required.
rules.forbidden_collapse: projection identity into a canonical typed root domain
rules.falsifier: Equal hexadecimal payloads are accepted across different root fields or schema domains.

rules.producer_state: valid producer signature over exact bytes
rules.required_behavior: Authenticate the bytes and signer only; verifier eligibility, reviewer authority, and Decision authority remain separately evaluated.
rules.forbidden_collapse: producer authentication into verifier or reviewer authorization
rules.falsifier: A producer signature grants verification eligibility, reviewer status, or Decision authority.

rules.producer_state: unsigned Web draft and payload root
rules.required_behavior: Keep the draft non-authoritative until the exact validated payload crosses the local DSSE signing boundary and the signed object is imported under Repository policy.
rules.falsifier: Hosted activity or a payload root alone is presented as a signed Submission or producer authorization.

rules.required_behavior: Retain unavailable on the source axis and refuse automatic Vela Verification conversion.
rules.forbidden_collapse: unavailable into pass, fail, error, or inconclusive Verification outcome
rules.falsifier: An adapter emits unavailable as a protocol outcome or maps it to a different protocol outcome.

adapter_requirements.requirement: MATH-01 and WEB-03 accept only an explicitly supported audit schema and version and fail closed before projection or conversion on every other value.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: An absent, unknown, future, or malformed schema/version is parsed best-effort or projected as current.

adapter_requirements.requirement: Every root is full and unshortened, and each field and schema domain is validated separately; equal hexadecimal payloads never authorize cross-domain substitution.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A shortened root, bare digest, wrong-domain root, or projection root is accepted in a canonical source, Artifact, Claim, Submission, Verification, Proposal, Repository, or authority field.

adapter_requirements.requirement: The adapter retains exact native object identity, native revision, audit core root, observation root, and update-detection evidence; changed source bytes or identity require a new observation and review.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A mutable branch, changed source artifact, reused native id, or drifted root silently resolves to the prior imported state.

adapter_requirements.requirement: The adapter declares completeness, pagination, exact bounds, and refusal behavior, then rejects truncation, incomplete pages, duplicate identities, or inputs beyond those bounds.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A partial or over-limit source read is presented as complete, or pagination state is omitted without refusal.

adapter_requirements.requirement: Each retained field and artifact declares whether bytes were copied or referenced and binds an exact locator, digest, access class, and custody limitation appropriate to that choice.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: Referenced bytes are presented as retained, copied bytes lack an exact digest, or a private locator is exposed through a public projection.

adapter_requirements.requirement: Every derived meaning names the exact interpreting implementation, method, version, and configuration required to reproduce it.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A later reader cannot identify which implementation interpreted the source bytes, or a different implementation is accepted under the same derived identity.

adapter_requirements.requirement: The adapter preserves native license and access facts, distinguishes public visibility from reuse rights, and applies an explicit public-redaction policy without claiming inaccessible evidence is public.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: Public visibility is treated as a license, private custody is labeled public, or a public consumer receives a private locator or restricted content.

adapter_requirements.requirement: The adapter declares meanings preserved, meanings omitted or approximated, facts unreconstructible by a later reader, and the exact evidence needed to reproduce every retained derivation.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A lossy projection claims source equivalence, an omitted condition disappears, or reconstruction requires undisclosed private operator context.

adapter_requirements.requirement: Each source field is classified immutable, mutable, or observation-time only, and the adapter declares deletion, tombstone, disappearance, and replacement behavior without rewriting historical observations.
adapter_requirements.falsifier: A disappeared or replaced source is silently deleted, rebound, or treated as if its historical observation never existed.

acceptance.adapter_gate: MATH-01 and WEB-03 must test every anti-collapse rule and adapter requirement against their real parser, mapper, renderer, custody, bounded-read, drift-detection, and refusal paths before freeze.
does_not_establish: A Formal Conjectures audit is a Vela Verification.
A source review, merge, or publication is a Vela Decision.
